issues.description: Wrong screen displayed. The app is showing the auth page instead of the step-7c Keep/Remove furniture detection screen. The URL shows /auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-7c, meaning the user is being redirected to auth before reaching step-7c. This indicates that step-7c is a protected route and the user session is not persisted/authenticated, causing the middleware or route guard to redirect to /auth.
issues.element: Entire page — showing auth instead of step-7c Keep/Remove screen
issues.root_cause: The route /design/step-7c requires authentication. The middleware or a route guard in apps/web/middleware.ts (or similar) is redirecting unauthenticated users to /auth. The test/QA session is not authenticated, so every attempt to visit step-7c lands on the auth page. Additionally, the console shows 'page:mount' event for 'auth' page multiple times and a 400 error on a resource load, suggesting auth state is not being set. The step-7c page itself may also be missing or not scaffolded.

issues.description: Console shows a 400 error on a failed resource load, likely related to an auth token or session API call failing during the auth page mount cycle.
issues.element: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 400
issues.root_cause: An API call during auth page initialization (possibly to Supabase or a session endpoint) is returning 400. This may be in the auth page component making a malformed request, or an OAuth callback URL mismatch.
